title: Back-Rank Checkmate
description: Black's king is trapped behind their own pawns. Deliver the decisive back-rank checkmate in one move!

title: Decisive Overload
description: Black has one rook guarding the back rank. Overload the defender with an aggressive sacrifice!

title: The Royal Knight Fork
description: White's knight has a devastating fork square that attacks both king and undefended rook.

title: Rook Skewer Tactic
description: Check Black's exposed king along the rank/file to win the stranded rook behind it!

title: Morphy's Opera Deflection
description: Inspired by Paul Morphy's 1858 Opera game: Queen sacrifice deflecting the knight to deliver checkmate with the rook!

title: Boden's Mate Theme
description: Sacrifice the Queen to shatter the pawn shield and deliver checkmate with criss-crossing bishops!
